programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Stambulo „Anadolu Efes“ - Miuncheno „Bayern“
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: EuroLeague. LDLC ASVEL Villeurbanne - AS Monaco
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: UFC. Jack Della Maddalena-Islam Makhachev
programme.desc: Martial Arts based TV programme. UFC stands for the Ultimate Fighting Championship which is an American mixed martial arts (MMA) promotion company based in Las Vegas that is owned by William Morris Endeavour.The purpose of UFC fighting was to establish the most effective martial art in a contest that had no weight classes and minimal rules that were as follows: no biting, hair pulling, groin shots and eye gouging. Legendary fighters well known for their ability to win in UFC fighting are Anderson Silva, Brock Lesnar, Connor McGregor and Ken Shamrock. Women's MMA has seen Ronda Rousey defend her title from 2012 to 2015 before she was defeated by Holly Holm another belt holder in more than one martial art.

programme.title: African Voices Playmakers: Warrior Women
programme.desc: Larry Madowo meets two trailblazing women redefining strength and resilience. Somali-born boxer Ramla Ali rose from refugee to Olympic athlete and advocate, using her platform to empower women worldwide. In Lagos, Nigerian police officer Juliet Ukah breaks barriers as the first African woman signed to the Professional Fighters League, proving that true warriors fight for more than victory.

programme.title: Connecting Africa: Food Security
programme.desc: Across the continent, food security is emerging as both a challenge and an opportunity. From climate-resilient seeds to cold-chain infrastructure and crop diversification, African agribusinesses are pioneering new ways to feed growing populations while creating sustainable export markets.

programme.title: Global Perspectives: Global Perspectives: On Africa
programme.desc: Hosted by Zain Asher, this special half-hour program showcases the best of CNN's inaugural \"Global Perspectives: On Africa\" event, featuring interviews and session highlights with high profile political and business leaders, innovators and thought-leaders.

programme.title: Inside Africa: Namibia's Culinary and Winemaking Excellence
programme.desc: Namibia's breathtaking landscapes draw travelers from around the world, but beyond its iconic desert landscapes and wildlife lies a new story of culinary and winemaking excellence. Through Wilderness Safari's pioneering hospitality and training initiatives, Neuras' award-winning wines, and the rise of visionary young chefs, Namibia is blending sustainability, culture, and innovation to redefine world-class wining and dining.

programme.title: CSI S4 E01 - Assume Nothing
programme.desc: Season 4 begins with terrific back-to-back episodes involving serial killers (\"Assume Nothing\" / \"For All Our Country\"). There's a new politically minded sheriff in town and in \"Invisible Evidence\" he's ticked off that the CSI's can't get enough evidence to convict a rapist/murderer. Also, Nick and Sara buck for the same promotion. Along the way there are plenty of quirky cases: one involving a museum robbery (\"Suckers\") and one involving a dead juror (\"Eleven Angry Jurors\"). Grissom travels to a small town with plenty of secrets to solve a murder in \"Jackpot,\" Catherine dates a younger man in \"Early Rollout,\" and Sara works a case involving a woman strikingly similar to herself in \"Butterflied.\" There's also plenty of kinkiness in \"Fur and Loathing\" and tragedy \"Bad Words.\".

programme.title: Dahil May Isang Ikaw
programme.desc: Anya (Regine Velasquez) accidentally bumps Andrew's (Aga Muhlach) car while backing up. Both were arguing whose fault it was. Later Anya discovers that Andrew is her client and she apologizes. She offers to treat him out to dinner. This becomes the start of the proverbial beautiful friendship.

programme.title: Miss Granny
programme.desc: Fely is an elderly woman who finds second chance at youth after a visit to a mysterious photo studio.

programme.title: Jeannie, Bakit Ngayon Ka Lang
programme.desc: A story of an ill-fated OFW whose hopes are once more afloat by a genie..the one that he’s been waiting forever.

programme.title: A Secret Affair
programme.desc: How will this love triangle sort itself? A Secret Affair tackles the theme about lies, temptations and rules in a relationship.

programme.title: My Zombabe
programme.desc: Due to a zombie apocalypse, Pong (Empoy Marquez) is the loneliest man on the planet. This all changes when Yasmin (Kim Molina) turns up, a beautiful woman in the process of zombifying.

programme.title: The Amazing Praybeyt Benjamin
programme.desc: A soldier who once saved the entire country is assigned to guard a genius child whose intellect is needed to foil the plans of an evil villain.

programme.title: D' Uragons
programme.desc: Sherlock, a private detective helps Orot, a street-smart fellow who is caught in a dilemma. The two soon discover the syndicate behind the robbery.

programme.title: Sugat Sa Puri
programme.desc: He has been a good man all his life. A dutiful son, a loving brother, a considerate friend. But one day, armed thugs barged into his quiet life and murder his family.

programme.title: Balahibong Pusa
programme.desc: Sarah is not happy about the idea of her mother Vivian getting married to Michael. But when she confronts her, Vivian described how happy she is, Sarah eventually gives her consent.

programme.title: Strebel, Gestapo ng Maynila
programme.desc: The era when Western Police District was truly, Manila’s Finest. Major Robert Strebel is a policeman whose strongest trait is his strong sense of duty. A law enforcer who is willing to take the extra length to get his responsibilities done.

programme.title: The Ship Show (Let Love Sail)
programme.desc: Twelve people are paired into two to compete in a reality show and be the country's next big love team.

programme.title: Isang Gabi
programme.desc: Karla mourns an abusive marriage while Dindo prepares for incarceration when they meet serendipitously at a bar. Unearthing an astounding shared truth entangles their trajectories, propelling them to shed light on long-suppressed turmoil.

programme.title: Kid Manalo, Akin Ang Ulo Mo!
programme.desc: His name is Marco (Gardo Versoza) but people call him Kid. Some years later, he finds himself in Manila as a taxi driver. An attache case containing some five million pesos is left in his cab.

programme.title: Abakada... Ina
programme.desc: An illiterate parent faces the challenges to her children's academic needs. A heart-warming drama featuring the award winning Nida Blanca, Albert Martinez and Lorna Tolentino.

programme.title: Instant Daddy
programme.desc: Valentin Roxas (Jerald Napoles) raises a baby left behind in his cab as his own daughter. But his life takes a sharp turn when the birth mother resurfaces.

programme.title: Spellbound
programme.desc: A Filipino adaptation of a South Korean film about Yuri (Bela Padilla), a woman haunted by ghosts after a car accident. Victor (Marco Gumabao), a street magician, turns her experiences into a popular horror-magic performance.

programme.title: Masikip Sa Dibdib
programme.desc: Rufa Mae Quinto will prick your hearts and keep you in stitches as Boobita Rose in this quirky dramedy from director Joyce Bernal.

programme.title: Seven Sundays
programme.desc: The Bonifacio siblings reunite when they find out their father is diagnosed with cancer. In the process, they have to deal with unresolved issues among themselves before it's too late.

programme.title: Filipinas
programme.desc: Filipinas tells the story of a family separated by rifts and conflicts.

programme.title: Anong Ganap?
programme.desc: Being in on the entertainment circle is quick and easy on PBO's Anong Ganap? Presented by the gorgeous entertainment anchor ng bayan, Phoemela Baranda.

programme.title: General Emilio Aguinaldo
programme.desc: General Emilio Aguinaldo is a three-hour epic chronicling his political rise, his rivalries and his struggle against the Spanish and American colonizers. It aims to present a comprehensive narration of his life, achievements and even some controversial issues about him.

programme.title: Mapupulang Rosas
programme.desc: Mapupulang Rosas.

programme.title: Ratratan
programme.desc: A peace-loving man is forced to live a life of violence when his daughter is kidnapped by a group of armed men. Unable to rely on law enforcers to go after the perpetrators, he decides to take matters into his own hand.

programme.title: Miracle in Cell No. 7
programme.desc: Joselito (Aga Muhlach), an intellectually-disabled man, is wrongfully charged assault and murder. In prison he becomes friends with his fellow inmates and together they form a plan to see his young daughter (Xia Vigor) inside the cell. Years after, his daughter (Bela Padilla) becomes a lawyer and is determined to prove her father's innocence.

programme.title: S2pid Luv
programme.desc: George and Bin are orphans with dreams of making it big in the music scene. But when they leave the orphanage to try their luck, they end up as helpers in a junk shop.

programme.title: Anong Ganap?
programme.desc: Being in on the entertainment circle is quick and easy on PBO's Anong Ganap? Presented by the gorgeous entertainment anchor ng bayan, Phoemela Baranda.

programme.title: Dulo
programme.desc: A young couple on the verge of separation takes a roadtrip to patch things up. Will this journey save their marriage or will it make them realize that it's the end for them?

programme.title: Maria
programme.desc: When a former BlackRose cartel assassin deliberately betrays them by refusing to complete her mission, the cartel orders her execution. Unbeknownst to them, she fakes her own death and is able to create a new life of her own.

programme.title: Nanay, Tatay
programme.desc: Three orphans escape captivity, get adopted by grieving parents who lost their demonically possessed daughter. The possessed daughter hunts the orphans, forcing them to commit crimes. Multiple deaths occur, including the parents.

programme.title: It's Cool Bulol
programme.desc: Red Sternberg stars as a campus nerd who has always been wanting to be accepted for what he is. He's smart, alright, but in an environment where substance takes a backseat to style, he is everybody's favorite laughingstock.

programme.title: Pagpag 24/7
programme.desc: Haunted by the ghost of a past crime, two friends find themselves stranded with strangers in a convenience store where abandoned souls await their victims.

programme.title: Till I Met You
programme.desc: Señor Manuel is an elderly gentleman who falls in love with the charming Luisa, a confident trickster posing as a rich socialite. Gabriel cares deeply for the old man and is very protective of the haciendero.

programme.title: Kiss Mo Ko
programme.desc: Clarisse is neglected by her boyfriend, James. Together with her friends Dindi and Cynthia, they create an imaginary suitor complete with a name- Aaron Nakpil.

programme.title: May-December-January
programme.desc: A single mother tests her relationship with her teenage son when she starts an affair with his best friend, for whom her son also harbours feelings.

programme.title: Tuli
programme.desc: Tuli centers on Daisy, daughter of the town’s sole manunuli or circumciser who has questions about her sexuality.

programme.title: Petrang Kabayo (2010)
programme.desc: Peter (Vice Ganda) is a boy who is always maltreated by his father because of his homosexuality. He decided to run away and was found by a wealthy lady, Doña Biday, and is adopted by her but becomes abusive of his new found wealth.

programme.title: Walang Kapalit
programme.desc: A marriage gone sour with the husband leaving the wife, taking along a minor daughter and lying to her about her mother. Meanwhile, each carries a relationship with other parties. Deciding to forego their annulment case, they commit to give their marriage a second try.

programme.title: BuyBust
programme.desc: After surviving the slaughter of her entire squad in a drug raid, anti-narcotics special operative Nina Manigan (Anne Curtis) is eager to go head-to-head with the drug cartels that hold a bloody grip on Manila. Trapped between a brutal drug gang and citizens, their only option is to fight their way out.

programme.title: The Barker
programme.desc: Coco (Empoy Marquez), is a simple jeepney barker who falls in love with Bella (Sky Carlos). Desperate to prove himself to Bella's family, Coco puts his life on the line to save them from kidnappers.

programme.title: ABNKKBSNPLAko? The Movie
programme.desc: The film follows the life of the character named Roberto Ong (Jericho Rosales). It checks the four phases of his life. From childhood memories, his best times in high school, his years in college and until his life as an working adult.

programme.title: Huwag Mong Takasan Ang Batas
programme.desc: Nelson used to live in the boondocks as an insurgent citizen. But soon he decides to mend his ways and start life anew. He then promises himself that he will live a peaceful life and give his sister Nene, the best he could provide.

programme.title: A.B. Normal College
programme.desc: Brace yourself as the hilarious guys of A.B. Normal College bring chaos and fun to their university! Andres (Andrew E.), Dominic (Ogie Alcasid) and Miguel (Mikey Arroyo), the school's most notorious students, are challenged when the school participates in a quiz show to upgrade the image of the school.

programme.title: Sunny
programme.desc: A Philippine adaptation of the 2011 hit Korean movie. Sunny is the story of a middle-aged woman who dreams to fulfill her dying wish to reunite with high school friends.

programme.title: A Hard Day
programme.desc: Dingdong Dantes (Detective Edmund Villon) plays a crooked policeman involved in a hit-and-run accident. John Arcilla (Lieutenant Ace Franco) plays another officer who tries to blackmail him.

programme.title: Isang Gabi
programme.desc: Karla mourns an abusive marriage while Dindo prepares for incarceration when they meet serendipitously at a bar. Unearthing an astounding shared truth entangles their trajectories, propelling them to shed light on long-suppressed turmoil.

programme.title: Momzillas
programme.desc: Clara and Minerva, the two women who shared the same man, meet again when their son and daughter, respectively, are about to marry each other.

programme.title: Gawin Sa Dilim 2
programme.desc: Traumatized by the tragic death of his girlfriend, Jerome drops out of school and retreats to the province where he opens his own inn. Though still broken-hearted, Jerome settles into his new abode and leads a more serene life.

programme.title: Ang Huling Birhen Sa Lupa
programme.desc: A priest, Father Emman (Jay Manalo), visits a small seaside town. Miling, a former nun who now teaches catechism on the island, thinks that father Emman is the priest she sent for.

programme.title: Basagan ng Mukha
programme.desc: Basagan ng Mukha.

programme.title: Fantastica
programme.desc: The proprietor of a struggling carnival must help a prince from another land find three lost princesses.

programme.title: Magnum Muslim .357
programme.desc: A Muslim undercover cop, Lieutenant Jamal Razul a.k.a Magnum (ER Ejercito) tracks down a criminal syndicate behind the kidnapping of the Muslim Princess Ameerah (Sam Pinto). Aided by fellow officer Joselito Ibanez (Jerico Ejercito), Razul discovers that there’s more to the kidnapping than mere ransom.

programme.desc: When Dick's employer goes bankrupt, he and his wife, Jane, go broke and look for ways to make ends meet. Eventually, they resort to crime and decide to rob a crooked CEO to get their money back.

programme.title: 50 First Dates
programme.desc: Henry falls in love with Lucy, whose short-term memory loss makes her forget him every time she falls asleep. As a result, Henry decides to win her over every day after she wakes up.

programme.title: DC League of Super-Pets
programme.desc: Superman and his super-dog Krypto share the same power and fight crime together. However, when Superman gets kidnapped, Krypto trains harder to rescue him.

programme.title: Firehouse Dog
programme.desc: Rexxx, a top Hollywood canine, gets lost and finds himself in a warehouse. He slowly realises his capabilities as a firehouse dog and befriends a young child to revamp the fire station.

programme.title: The Smurfs 2
programme.desc: When Gargamel learns that Smurfette knows a secret spell that can turn Naughties, Smurf-like creatures, into real Smurfs, he kidnaps her. The Smurfs set out to rescue Smurfette.

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: Grace, who is vacationing in Paris with her friends and stepsister, is mistaken for a British heiress. Later, the three women are whisked away to Monte Carlo, where they discover royalty and romance.

programme.title: Raging Bull
programme.desc: A middleweight ascends through the ranks to achieve his first shot at a boxing title. But his personal life, laden with paranoia, jealousy and rage, scuttles his professional growth.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: When Django, a slave, is freed, he joins forces with a bounty hunter to rescue his wife, who has been enslaved by Calvin, a hard-hearted plantation owner.

programme.title: Land of the Bears
programme.desc: The filmmaker shines a light on the lives of five wild brown bears inhabiting the Kamchatka Peninsula, exploring their daily adventures and activities.

programme.title: DSC
programme.desc: Talented directors provide an entertaining insight into the most intriguing stories and anecdotes concerning some of their best works.

programme.title: The Family Fang
programme.desc: After the police inform them about their parents' mysterious disappearance, two siblings embark on a mission to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Mune
programme.desc: Necross, the former guardian of the sun, turns evil and steals it. Now, Mune, Glim and Sohone, three friends, must work together to retrieve it back from him.

programme.title: Fly Me to the Moon
programme.desc: Isabelle plans to marry a stranger to break a family curse, which leads every first marriage to end in a divorce, in order to get married to her long-time boyfriend Pierre.

programme.title: Texas Killing Fields
programme.desc: In a small town in Texas, a homicide detective and his partner embark on a challenging mission to arrest a vicious serial killer.

programme.title: Casino Jack
programme.desc: Jack Abramoff, a powerful lobbyist, carves a luxurious and influential life for himself. However, things become complicated when he starts interacting with organised crime.

programme.title: Little Women
programme.desc: Time, ambition and the pursuit of happiness define and mould the March sisters as they face various challenges at the cusp of womanhood.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Forrest, a man with low IQ, recounts the early years of his life when he found himself in the middle of key historical events. All he wants now is to be reunited with his childhood sweetheart, Jenny.

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: Wealthy speedboat racer Ben Aronoff leads a secret life that lands him in trouble with both law enforcement and drug lords.

programme.title: Guilty by Suspicion
programme.desc: Owing to his alleged involvement with communist parties, a film director is forbidden from working in Hollywood. Furthermore, he faces numerous challenges while fighting for his rights.

programme.title: The Da Vinci Code
programme.desc: A dying curator of the Louvre hides cryptic clues on Da Vinci paintings. Now it is up to Robert Langdon and Sophie Neveu to follow the clues and unearth a secret kept hidden for centuries.

programme.title: Boychoir
programme.desc: A demanding choir master at an elite East Coast boarding school pushes a gifted but troubled orphan to fulfil his true potential.
